description: This line plot illustrates the overall ROUGE-2 score for six different models—PELMS (5%), Primera, Primera (5%), Pegasus-X, Pegasus-X (5%), and Centrum (5%)—as a function of the number of training examples, ranging from 0 to 64. The x-axis, labeled “# Training Examples,” uses a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 16, spanning from 0 to 64. The y-axis, labeled “Overall ROUGE-2 Score,” uses a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 1.0, ranging from 11.0 to 19.0. The PELMS (5%) model is represented by a solid green line with circular markers, starting at approximately 17.0 and rising to about 18.9. The Primera model is shown as a solid red line with square markers, beginning at approximately 15.0 and increasing to about 17.7. The Primera (5%) model is depicted as a dashed red line with square markers, starting at approximately 15.0 and rising to about 17.7. The Pegasus-X model is represented by a solid blue line with triangular markers, beginning at approximately 13.5 and rising to about 14.5. The Pegasus-X (5%) model is shown as a dashed green line with circular markers, starting at approximately 17.0 and rising to about 18.9. The Centrum (5%) model is represented by a solid yellow line with diamond markers, beginning at approximately 15.0 and rising to about 15.7. The Centrum model is shown as a dashed yellow line with diamond markers, beginning at approximately 15.0 and rising to about 15.7.
